title: AppSettingsUpdate
description:
The writable fields of app settings as a merge patch. Custom tools have their own
probe-validated endpoints, so a settings write preserves them instead of bypassing that
probe. An absent field keeps its stored value; a present field replaces it.

delete_chunks_on_success.description: Whether encoded chunks are deleted after a successful run.

reduce_motion.description: Reduce motion even when the operating system does not ask for it.

temp_dir.description: Temporary-directory override; `null` uses the app-data default.
